hero_description: Deliver production-grade, secure, and cost-effective databases to every tenant with a single Kubernetes-native DBaaS platform. Built for internal developers and modern SaaS scalability.
when_to_use_subtitle: Modern SaaS needs databases that scale with tenants — not against them.

when_to_use.title: Security & Isolation
when_to_use.description: Prevent noisy neighbors and credential sprawl with isolated namespaces and fine-grained access.

when_to_use.title: Instant Self-Service
when_to_use.description: Developers on-board customers faster with automated database provisioning via Helm or APIs.

when_to_use.title: Cost Optimization
when_to_use.description: Bin-pack multi-tenant workloads more efficiently than hyperscaler DBaaS instances.

when_to_use.title: Multi-Cloud Portability
when_to_use.description: Run your database layer consistently across EKS, GKE, AKS, or your own bare-metal clusters.

platform_features_subtitle: KubeDB provides the control plane you need for large-scale SaaS operations.

platform_features.title: Namespace Isolation
platform_features.description: Each tenant gets isolated namespaces with RBAC, network policies, and resource quotas.

platform_features.title: Centralized Governance
platform_features.description: Enforce security, backup schedules, and version upgrades across all tenants from one plane.

platform_features.title: Built-in Observability
platform_features.description: Native Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for every database instance.

platform_features.title: KubeStash Backups
platform_features.description: Automated, incremental, encrypted backups to any object store with PITR support.

platform_features.title: Zero-Downtime Operations
platform_features.description: Automated upgrades, scaling, and failover with full lifecycle management.

platform_features.title: Any Kubernetes, Anywhere
platform_features.description: Works on-prem, public cloud, hybrid, air-gapped, and multi-cluster environments.

platform_features.title: Multi-Team Support
platform_features.description: Isolated namespaces and resources for different teams with fine-grained access control.

platform_features.title: Usage Metering
platform_features.description: Track resource consumption and costs per team with built-in chargeback capabilities.

platform_features.title: GitOps Integration
platform_features.description: Infrastructure as code with Git-based workflows for declarative database management.

comparison_subtitle: KubeDB provides more control and lower costs than standard hyperscaler database services.
cta_title: Ready to scale your SaaS infrastructure?
cta_description: Join the leading SaaS teams who have built their internal DBaaS on KubeDB Platform.
